recommendation: Implement post-discharge follow-up for heart failure patients
implementation_steps: Oversee care transitions and ensure timely post-discharge follow-up within 7 days to reduce readmissions
Develop and communicate individualized care plans across the care team
Monitor for heart failure progression and coordinate laboratory and diagnostic testing
Facilitate rapid initiation and titration of guideline-directed medical therapy (GDMT)
Screen for depression, frailty, health literacy, and social isolation
evidence_summary: Structured post-discharge follow-up within 7 days has been shown to significantly reduce hospital readmissions and mortality in heart failure patients across multiple randomized controlled trials and meta-analyses.
citation: Disease Management Interventions for Heart Failure (Cochrane Review)
